review.reviewer: Codex KB Alt implementation owner (agent self-review; not independent approval)
review.decision: Preserve alternate text explicitly in new review records; retire the rejected historical-inheritance expectation
review.notes: Incremental self-review after independent P1 on 6afe22bcbc3c56c0e1d9bab6c92cb977fdd7f29a. Existing B documentation and KBL-002 explicitly invalidated stale translations, so the lack of an explicit clear field never justified restoring historical omitted Alt. KBA-001/002/004 case objects remain unchanged and still cover new prepare/check/apply, updates and protections. KBA-003 is retired and replaced by KBAR-001 through KBAR-003 in a new test file, preserving the rejected expectation and its red/green records in Git and the old package. This move makes the changed replay contract auditable with a fresh design before the new file first exists, without rewriting pushed history or weakening unrelated checks. New prepare persists retained Alt explicitly; fold only clones serialized Alt, never inherits nil. Omission/null in new proposals preserves; omission in old serialized supersedes retains historical reset semantics. No clear API or version marker introduced. Independent re-review and exact new CI remain pending.

cases.description: Review JSON omission and null preserve bilingual bytes through prepare/check/apply/retry
cases.setup: Synthetic Chinese entry with English alternate containing whitespace, multiline Markdown and Unicode; separate no-Alt variant under disposable test HOME.
cases.action: Read proposal JSON through readReview; prepare and mutate prepared Alt to check aliasing; check and apply through normal CLI; inspect appended op and live state; repeat identical apply and stale competing proposal.
cases.expected: Exact alternate lang/title/body survives when absent or null, no-Alt remains nil. Dry run changes no files; ledger stores preserved Alt, input is immutable, identity/receipts remain normal; identical retry does not append and stale CAS changes no bytes.

cases.description: Explicit bilingual update is parsed, validated and committed atomically
cases.setup: Same synthetic live entry; complete replacement Alt supplied in JSON, plus invalid alternate language/same language/blank or multiline or oversized title/body and a retire carrying an Alt.
cases.action: Read/check/apply valid JSON, compare digest when only Alt differs, test pure preparation and mutate replacement input; reject invalid whole batches before append; retry changed proposal against old revision.
cases.expected: New alternate replaces every field exactly and contributes to proposal digest. Unknown fields remain errors; invalid alternates and an Alt attached to retire are refused rather than ignored. Omitted/null preserves and does not mean deletion; no clear API invented. New bytes reach pick/API readers; CAS, batch atomicity and idempotence remain.

cases.description: Retired historical-inheritance expectation, replaced by KBAR-001 through KBAR-003
cases.setup: In-memory historical reviewed ops lacking Alt, explicit replacement, consecutive reviews, explicit alt(nil) before/after a review, ordinary supersede before review, retired/re-added or retitled predecessors.
cases.action: Fold without writes; compare input serialization; mutate inherited Alt; inspect live entries and original objects.
cases.expected: Retired after the independent P1 on Q6afe22bc: historical nil supersedes must not restore old translations. Corrected historical fallback, future explicit persistence and replay boundaries live in KBAR-001 through KBAR-003; the rejected old expectation and source remain auditable in earlier Git and package snapshots.

cases.description: Alt retention coexists with existing complete source and lifecycle regression
cases.setup: Existing KBL source shapes with protected memory, sensitive confirmation, distribution intent, full Sources and seven origins plus post-add hit/unrelated guard.
cases.action: Refresh reviewed KBL-002 expectation to exact Alt preservation; run full source-lineage and knowledge tests including ordinary supersede and subsequent hits.
cases.expected: Review now retains exact Alt in prepare, append and live entry while existing seven-origin/full-source, latest hit, guard, language/status/audience/privacy, card demotion, landing reopen, CAS and retry assertions stay effective. Ordinary write contracts remain unchanged. This design supersedes only prior KBL-002 alternate invalidation expectation.
